verdict.rationale: A database product could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only adjacent features: cloud-hosted embedding models, agent skills for external coding assistants, and an MCP server. None of these is an in-product feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
